args.subject: Group booking enquiry – 10 guests in June
args.body:
Hello,

I am organising a group stay at City Hub Tokyo and would like to ask about availability for 10 people in June. Could you please let me know which dates are available, the group rates, and what the booking process involves?

Thank you, and I look forward to your reply.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech

final_text:
I emailed groups@cityhub-tokyo.jp, the group-bookings address from one of the City Hub reviews. The hotel is listed in Tokyo simply as "City Hub".

The email asks about availability for 10 people in June, the group rates, and how the booking process works. It's signed with your name and Blue Sparrow Tech. I didn't specify exact dates, since you didn't give any. Once they reply, you can send them your preferred dates.
